name: win-native
description: WIN — application de navigation pour l'Algerie. Monorepo Node.js : API Fastify + application mobile React Native.

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.build: npm run build -w @win/shared && npm run build -w @win/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @win/shared && npm run typecheck -w @win/api
